faults.inFlightRejected: KLayout renderer stopped. Retry the viewport.

findings: Observed source-switch worker exit overlap: 1.006 ms, 0.559 ms, 1.048 ms
interpretation: This run completed 1200 varying-ROI worker requests and 1200 immediate cache replays over four 15-second epochs.
Cold modes were 1118 exact and 82 empty; this soak did not trigger overview fallback or cache eviction. Those paths require their separate evidence.
Source changes reset the cache. Four bounded epochs do not establish long-session leak freedom or performance on larger industrial designs.
Timing is end-to-end RasterService response latency without GUI upload, WebGL drawing, input-to-frame latency, or FPS.
Worker ru_maxrss is a per-process high-water measurement; monotonic growth alone is not evidence of a leak. Parent Node RSS is current RSS.
Three source changes briefly overlapped an exiting SIGKILL-signalled worker and its replacement. Strict single-live-process behavior is not established; one not-yet-signalled worker was observed.
